name: COMM 3460
title: Sport Communication
description: Communication theory and best practices in the realm of sport, with a focus on application to modern issues for organizations, athletes, and fans at varying levels of competition.
requirement_description: COMM 1000. Recommended Preparation: COMM 2100 or 2300 or 2500. Not open for credit to students who have passed COMM 3498 when offered as Sports Communication.
